items.title: Nobody can replace Jensen Huang. What that means for AI
items.summary: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia after a week of alleged spy ties, reported affairs and a resignation, with about $2 trillion gone from Nvidia's value. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why he was a one-of-one founder, who might replace him, the rivals circling Nvidia and why a China chip ban could backfire.

items.title: Jim Cramer: Anthropic’s “Next $100 Billion in Revenue” Might Be Cybersecurity. CrowdStrike Should Worry
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDays before Anthropic’s IPO, Jim Cramer named cybersecurity as a possible source of the AI lab’s next $100 billion in revenue, given how good Claude is at spotting code vulnerabilities. A bigger Claude security push would make Anthropic a direct competitor to CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks, which both jumped nearly 3% early on Nov.
